requirements.requirement: The system must define a sponsor object schema containing a required string field for sponsor_name.
The system must define a sponsor_type field as a string with controlled values (e.g., industry, academic, government, nonprofit).
The system must define a funding_source field restricted to the enum values public, private, or undisclosed.
The system must define a collaborators field as an array of strings representing collaborating organizations.
The system must define a score_contribution field as a numeric or string value representing the sponsor’s contribution to the trial score.
The system must ensure the schema is compatible with the backend response structure from EVAL-CT-MEASURE-SPONSOR.
The system must define all required fields with explicit types to support direct rendering in MessageBubble.tsx without additional inference.
The system must allow optional fields (e.g., collaborators) to be omitted without breaking the schema contract.
The system must include nullability definitions for fields that may be missing in backend data.
The system must validate that funding_source values outside the allowed enum are rejected or mapped to undisclosed.
The system must support multiple collaborators in the schema without requiring a fixed maximum length.
The system must ensure the schema can be serialized and passed through the existing frontend API response pipeline without transformation errors.
The system must handle the exception where sponsor_name is missing by marking the schema invalid.
The system must handle the exception where collaborators is not an array by rejecting the payload or coercing it into a valid array format.
